connector.name: Lithtrix
connector.registryDescription: Search, browse, memory and blob storage for AI agents. One key at lithtrix.ai, Spark trial free.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package lithtrix-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the learningloons-hash account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LITHTRIX_API_KEY
env.description: Your Lithtrix API key (ltx_...). Register free at https://lithtrix.ai/v1/register — Spark trial included, no card required. Or use the lithtrix_register tool.

env.name: LITHTRIX_PASSPORT_MASTER_SEED
env.description: Optional. UTF-8 passphrase for lithtrix_passport_derive and lithtrix_delegate signing — never sent to the Lithtrix API.

env.name: LITHTRIX_PASSPORT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional. PKCS#8 PEM Ed25519 private key for lithtrix_delegate signing (client-side only).

env.name: LITHTRIX_API_URL
env.description: Optional. Override the Lithtrix API base URL. Defaults to https://api.lithtrix.ai.
